**Nivyx v2.2.1 — documentation and release UX polish only.**

- Improved README installation layout (one clean section per platform)
- Clearer platform download guidance and a table explaining every release asset
- Filled in the measured v2.2 package sizes in `docs/performance-v2.2.md`
- No engine/runtime behavior changes

No DPI engine, DNS, TLS, WinDivert, PF, nftables, update, repair, or service behavior changed in this release. The only code-adjacent change is the version string (`2.2.1`) and the end-to-end tests deriving the version they patch from the build instead of a literal.
